app.name: Synaplan Desktop
app.tagline: Your Synaplan account on this computer

pair.title: Pair this computer
pair.intro: Synaplan Desktop connects this computer to your Synaplan workspace. Open Synaplan in your browser, go to Channels → Desktop, and create a pairing code.
pair.keyHint: For recovery: paste a scoped key you already created. The address is still required.

chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: Ask anything. Your messages use your Synaplan account.
chat.skillsActiveHint: Skills can create files on this computer
chat.emptySkills: Ask for a document, a summary, an email draft… enabled skills can create files for you.
chat.placeholderSkills: Ask your assistant to make something…
chat.consentBody: To create files, Synaplan Desktop runs installed skills locally. It only runs reviewed skill scripts — never arbitrary commands.
chat.consentPoint1: Only allowlisted tools (Python, Node, LibreOffice) run — never a shell.
chat.consentPoint2: Files are written only to the out-box folder.
chat.consentPoint3: You can change allowed folders under This computer.

studio.heroLead: Three starting examples. Click one, or type your own.
studio.chooseHint: These tiles appear on an empty chat. Pick up to three.
studio.genericPrompt: Use the {name} skill. Read its full SKILL.md path listed for that skill, then do what I ask. Ask me for anything you need, then write the result into the out-box.

followupEmail.title: Follow up in Outlook
followupEmail.lead: An unsent message you open, edit, and send yourself
followupEmail.prompt: Write an unsent follow-up email I can open in Outlook. Ask me who it is for and what we agreed, then save a .eml in the out-box.

meetingInvite.title: Put it on the calendar
meetingInvite.lead: An invite you can double-click into Outlook
meetingInvite.prompt: Create a calendar invite I can open in Outlook. Ask me for the title, start, and end, then save an .ics in the out-box.

saveContact.title: Save a contact
saveContact.lead: A card you can import into Outlook
saveContact.prompt: Create a contact card I can import into Outlook. Ask me for name, email, phone, company, and title, then save a .vcf in the out-box.

invoice.title: Send a clean invoice
invoice.lead: A print-ready page you can save as PDF
invoice.prompt: Create a print-ready invoice as HTML I can open in a browser and print to PDF. Ask me for sender, client, line items, and tax, then save it in the out-box.

slides.title: Pitch it in five slides
slides.lead: A deck that opens in any browser
slides.prompt: Create a five-slide pitch deck as HTML I can open in a browser. Ask me for the topic and key points, then save it in the out-box.

brief.title: One-page brief from notes
brief.lead: A tidy page from messy text
brief.prompt: Turn my notes into a one-page HTML brief I can open in a browser or Word. Ask me for the notes or topic, then save it in the out-box.

spreadsheet.title: What’s in this spreadsheet
spreadsheet.lead: A short profile of a CSV
spreadsheet.prompt: Profile a CSV and write a Markdown report in the out-box. Ask me which file to use, or explain that I need to add a readable folder under This computer first.

chart.title: Chart these numbers
chart.lead: A bar or line chart you can open
chart.prompt: Create a chart as HTML I can open in a browser. Ask me for the numbers or a CSV, then save it in the out-box.

table.title: Searchable table
table.lead: A filterable table from a CSV
table.prompt: Create a searchable HTML table from a CSV. Ask me which file to use, then save it in the out-box.

chat.emptyProject: Start a chat in {name}. Answers use this project's models.
chat.noChatModel: No Chat model is set for this project yet, so nothing can be sent.
chat.noThreads: No chats yet in this project.
chat.assistantHint: Assistant used for this thread. It runs with this project's models.

projects.lastProject: The last project cannot be deleted.
projects.createBody: A project keeps chats, notes and files together. Chats and notes stay on this computer.
projects.renameBody: Only the name changes. The folder on this computer and the knowledge folder on Synaplan keep their names.
projects.dictationLanguageHint: Used when you dictate notes or messages in this project.
projects.modelsLater: You choose this project's models under Models.
projects.deleteBody: Chats and settings of this project are removed from this computer.
projects.deleteNotesToo: Also delete the notes folder on this computer:
projects.deleteSynaplanNote: Files already sent to Synaplan stay in that knowledge folder. Remove them from Synaplan on the web if you want them gone.

notes.title: Notes
notes.emptyBody: Notes are Markdown files in this folder. They stay on this computer unless you share one.
notes.localOnly: Notes stay on this computer unless you share one.
notes.noNotes: No notes yet in this project.
notes.deleteBody: The file is removed from this computer. This cannot be undone.
notes.placeholder: Start writing. The first heading becomes the title.

files.title: Files
files.emptyTitle: Add files to this project's knowledge folder.
files.emptyBody: They are sent to your Synaplan workspace and indexed with the model you picked for this project.
files.embedUnset: No model for indexing files is set for this project yet.
files.dropHere: Drop files here to add them to this project.
files.dropBlocked: Files cannot be added until an indexing model is set.
files.pathPlaceholder: Or type the full path of a file
files.allowedFoldersNote: Files must come from a folder this app may use.
files.outsideAllowed: This file is not in a folder this app may use. Add its folder under This computer.
files.none: No files in this project yet.
files.removeBody: The file and its index are deleted from your workspace. The original on this computer is not touched.
files.pickTitle: Add files to the knowledge folder

agents.title: Agents
agents.intro: Assistants come from your Synaplan workspace. Skills run on this computer.

models.title: This project's models
models.sovereignty: Data is processed only by the models you picked for this project.
models.intro: Choose the models that may process this project's data.

chat.label: Chat
chat.hint: Answers in Chat and for Skills

embed.label: Index files
embed.hint: Makes files in the knowledge folder searchable

docs.label: Documents
docs.hint: Reads the text out of added documents

models.loadFailed: The model list could not be loaded. Your picks are kept.
models.catalogMissing: This workspace has not sent the model list yet. Your picks are kept.
models.fallbackNote: Chat and Dictation show a basic list without readiness information.
models.notInList: {model} is no longer offered by this workspace. Pick another model or clear it.
models.legacyPick: Picked before the model list existed; it will be matched when the list arrives.
models.noneForSlot: No model available for this use

skills.title: Skills
skills.body: Install and manage Agent Skills that run on this computer.
skills.intro: Skills are small tools that can run on this computer. Enable the ones you trust.
skills.mayRunPrograms: May run programs on this computer
skills.pythonMissing: Some skills run Python scripts, but Python was not found on this computer.
skills.folderPlaceholder: Path to a folder that contains SKILL.md
skills.confirmPoint1: This skill can run programs and read files you allow.
skills.confirmPoint2: Synaplan did not write or review community skills.
skills.confirmPoint3: You can disable or remove it at any time.
skills.otherAssistant: Written for another assistant; it may not work here.
skills.removeBody: The skill folder will be deleted from this computer. Included skills cannot be removed.
skills.unattendedTitle: Allow {name} to run when you are away?
skills.unattendedBody: This skill may run a program on this computer without anyone at the keyboard. There is no setting that allows every skill to do this.

computer.title: This computer
computer.body: Choose which folders skills may read and where files are saved. Coming in a later update.
computer.intro: Choose which folders skills may read. Files that skills create are saved in your out-box.
computer.pollNever: This computer has not checked in yet.
computer.pollPlaintext: Background jobs are off while the key is stored in a plaintext file.
computer.autostart: Start when I sign in to this computer
computer.autostartHint: Optional. Turning this off removes the login entry.
computer.emptyReadFolders: No folders added yet. Skills can only read folders you add here.

doctor.title: Check this computer
doctor.body: Check that Python, Node, and LibreOffice are available for skills.
doctor.intro: These local tools let skills run on this computer. A missing tool only blocks the skills that need it.
doctor.hintPythonWindows: Windows may show a Python placeholder. Install Python from python.org.
doctor.hintPythonMac: Install Python 3 from python.org or Homebrew. The system placeholder does not count.
doctor.hintPythonLinux: Install python3 with your distribution's package manager (and python3-venv).
doctor.hintLibreoffice: Install LibreOffice from libreoffice.org for document conversion skills.
doctor.hintLibreofficeFlatpak: LibreOffice is installed via Flatpak. Conversion may fail unless it can see your out-box folder.
doctor.hintPythonVenv: Python is installed, but the venv module is missing. Install python3-venv with your package manager.
doctor.hintPythonPackages: Python is installed, but a required package is missing. Install it yourself — Synaplan does not run pip for you.

status.plaintextWarning: Your key is stored in a plaintext file because no secure store was available. This is not recommended.

inout.hint: What this project has taken in and what it has produced.

inout.outHint: What skills produced for this project, on this computer.

dictation.prompt: Notes and spoken sentences. Keep punctuation. Do not summarise. Do not invent names. Transcribe only what was said.
dictation.needModel: Pick a Dictation model for this project under Models to dictate.
